http_request_firewall_custom.description: [stowplan] Skip zone rate limits on other hosts

http_ratelimit.description: [stowplan] Limit sensitive API requests by source
http_ratelimit.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/account" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/account/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/admin" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/admin/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/workspaces" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/workspaces/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/sync" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/snapshot")

http_ratelimit.description: [stowplan] Limit sensitive API requests by source
http_ratelimit.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/account" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/account/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/admin" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/admin/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/workspaces" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/workspaces/"))

http_ratelimit.description: [stowplan] Limit data API requests by source
http_ratelimit.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/sync" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/snapshot")
http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/"))

http_ratelimit.description: [stowplan] Limit guest redemption requests by source
http_ratelimit.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/guest" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/guest/"))

http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/account" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/account/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/admin" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/admin/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/workspaces" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/workspaces/"))

http_ratelimit.description: [stowplan] Limit data API requests by source
http_ratelimit.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/sync" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/snapshot")

http_request_firewall_custom.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and len(http.request.cookies["__Host-stowplan_session"]) gt 1

http_request_firewall_custom.description: [stowplan] Block oversized data API request bodies
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/sync" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/snapshot") and http.request.body.size gt 8388608

http_request_firewall_custom.description: [stowplan] Block oversized workspace access request bodies
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/workspaces" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/workspaces/")) and http.request.body.size gt 32768

http_request_firewall_custom.description: [stowplan] Block oversized control API request bodies
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and http.request.uri.path ne "/api/sync" and http.request.uri.path ne "/api/snapshot" and http.request.body.size gt 262144

http_ratelimit.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/"))

http_ratelimit.description: [stowplan] Limit guest redemption requests by source
http_ratelimit.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/guest" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/guest/"))

http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/account" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/account/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/admin" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/admin/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/workspaces" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/workspaces/"))

http_ratelimit.description: [stowplan] Limit data API requests by source
http_ratelimit.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/sync" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/snapshot")

http_ratelimit.description: [stowplan] Limit authenticated API requests by session
http_ratelimit.expression: http.host eq "stowplan.jklein.dev" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and len(http.request.cookies["__Host-stowplan_session"]) gt 0
